Dear Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week (Nov 23-27). My calendar has these open half-hours inside working hours:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Thursday 10:00-10:30
- Thursday 14:00-14:30

Would any of these suit you? If you prefer another slot, just tell me the day and time and I'll fit it in.

Best,
Sarah

Dear Sarah,

Monday 10:00-10:30 works well for me — I've put it in my calendar for next week (Nov 23), right after the curriculum committee and before my paper review. See you then.

Best,
Professor Alvarez

Dear Professor Alvarez,

Monday 10:00-10:30 it is — I've booked it for next week (Nov 23).

Best,
Sarah

Hello,

I'm finalising my calendar for next week (Nov 23-27). Could you send me the official schedule for that week — lectures, seminars and university meetings — so I can check nothing is missing or moved?

Thank you,
Sarah
Perfect — it's in my calendar too. See you Monday.

CSE Department Office

Dear department office,

Thank you — I've noted the week. Two points:

1. My 1:1 with Prof. Alvarez next Monday 10:00-10:30 is clear of everything on your list, so it stands.
2. A few entries overlap commitments already on my calendar — Monday 13:00-14:00 Colloquium (I have 12:30-14:00 blocked) and Thursday 10:30-11:50 Department seminar (I have 10:30-11:20 blocked). Could you confirm which of the listed events I'm expected to attend? The list contains entries that overlap each other (e.g. Tuesday 09:00-10:30 CSE455 lecture and 09:50-11:10 Seminar), so I don't want to assume the whole list is mine.

Best regards,
Sarah

Dear Sarah,

The list is the department's official schedule of next week's lectures, seminars and university meetings — it is not a list of your personal obligations, so I cannot say which of those events you are expected to attend. That is for the organisers of each event (and for whatever you have arranged with Professor Alvarez) to decide; I don't have your calendar and don't arrange anyone's meetings.

What I can confirm:
- The times as published are unchanged, including Monday 13:00–14:00 Colloquium and Thursday 10:30–11:50 Department seminar.
- The overlaps you noticed are in the published schedule itself (different events, sometimes different audiences) — the CSE455 lecture on Tuesday is 09:00–10:30, the Seminar 09:50–11:10. Nothing has been moved or cancelled.

For the two you mention: if you need to know whether attendance is required of you specifically, the colloquium and seminar organisers can tell you. I'll be glad to confirm any published time or room.

Best regards,
CSE Department Office

Dear department office,

Understood — thank you for clarifying, and for confirming the published times are unchanged. I'll keep the list for reference.

Best regards,
Sarah

You're welcome, Sarah — glad it helps. Write any time if you need a time or room confirmed.

CSE Department Office
